title: What if your competitive friend could run at light speed?
idea: What if, episode 3: the friend who has to win runs at light speed; three races he wins before they start, then around the world: two seconds for him, sixty years for his friends

hook.what: two friends crouched at a start line glaring at each other; green sparks at Samurai's feet: 'Watch me win at light speed!'

captions.text: Watch me win at light speed!
WHAT IF YOUR COMPETITIVE FRIEND COULD RUN AT LIGHT SPEED?
Real fact: the faster you move, the slower your time runs.
Would you still want to win?
